instructions: Review each item under `## Failing checks` and decide whether it needs a code change.
Triage `## Failing checks`. Playbook: "CI failure triage".

Triage the merge-queue ejection before any requeue. GitHub records no automatic reason for this removal, so a person may have dequeued the PR. Do not update the branch from base or enqueue the PR for this removal. Fix the failure only if it belongs to this PR. Playbook: "Merge queue ejection".
If you changed code, commit any remaining changes and push to the PR head branch. If you did not, do not commit.

For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`. Playbook: "Shepherd Journal".
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. Iterate immediately with the same options.
